_comment: MCP fleet memory budget for the standard acceptance load (3 concurrent claude-haiku sessions, real CTE, data-semantics blueprint, settle >= 180s so the fleet reaper's 120s TTL elapses before FINAL). RATCHET: these numbers only go DOWN — record from >=3 runs, and the 5% runtime tolerance must cover HONEST variance including a COLD box: spawn-diet plans expire after 24h, so a release-cadence gate run boots with undieted declared chains at the listing pass — peak is recorded at the observed cold maximum, not the warm median. Never raise these to make a regression pass. Enforced live by scripts/mcp_mem_attribution.py --assert-budget (release-gating, see the release skill), and pinned at or under campaign_targets by tests/test_scripts/test_mcp_mem_budget.py so the budget can never regress above the #930 campaign line. Scope: the whole server process tree PLUS any pre-existing external clio-core daemon (sampled explicitly), INCLUDING provider-CLI processes (claude SDK CLI). History: 3.57 peak==final at campaign start (#929, 2026-07-14) -> after #931-#934 (2026-07-15): warm peaks 1.16/1.28/1.28 (median 1.28), cold-boot-listing peak observed 1.42 (recorded, cap 1.49), finals 0.72/0.74/0.72 (median 0.72 recorded — FINAL is post-reap where diet state is irrelevant). RE-RECORDED 2026-09-03 at the NEW N=4 default (owner parallel-by-default ruling, #1305: max_concurrent_claude_processes 1 -> 4, so the acceptance load now holds up to 4 resident claude-CLI subprocesses instead of 1 - a deliberate product-behavior change, NOT a regression pass): 3 runs peak 2.84/3.20/2.94 (cold-observed max 3.20 recorded), finals 1.36/0.80/0.81 (median 0.81 - BETTER than the 2026-07-15 final 0.72+fleet because #1305's deterministic per-subagent lifecycle release now reaps provider connections at task terminal). Substrate note: recorded against the session-private real clio-core daemon via scripts/live_verification/run_with_private_cte.py (the box's user-level daemon cannot preflight its 50GB file tier on current free disk); daemon RSS is in-tree and counted.
load: 3 concurrent claude-haiku sessions, real CTE, data-semantics blueprint, --settle-s >= 180

campaign_targets._comment: Re-based 2026-09-03 for the parallel-by-default product (owner ruling, #1305): the #930 1.8/1.3 line measured a serialized-LM product (N=1) that no longer exists; the new peak envelope allows the 4-CLI workload (~0.35 GB each) atop the non-provider floor. The final target is UNCHANGED - lifecycle release must keep post-idle memory at the old line.

children._comment: BACKGROUND-CHILDREN scenario (#955 S7): the standard acceptance load (3 concurrent claude-haiku sessions on the real CTE) where session 0 drives the S5 canary blueprint (out/s5-gate/canary-pack) and FANS OUT 2 background children (alpha+beta via spawn_agents_parallel), while sessions 1-2 run the data-semantics load. Children are REAL child sessions: resident_ledgers caps their transcripts (absorbed inside server-main, which stays ~0.28 GB) and the #933 workspace-fleet reaper cleans their fleets (workspace_fleet_reaped reason=idle_ttl observed every run; FINAL is post-reap). Same RATCHET rule as the baseline block: peak = observed COLD max (not warm median), final = median of >=3 runs, and the 5% tolerance must cover honest cold-boot variance. Never raise these to make a regression pass; if the children scenario exceeds a bound, attribute it (harness reports by process/role) and fix the root. History (2026-07-19, this box, real CTE on 9413, claude_code/haiku): 3 runs peak 1.01/0.96/0.95 (cold max 1.01 recorded, cap 1.06), final 0.72/0.73/0.75 (median 0.73 recorded, cap 0.767). Attribution at PEAK: claude-sdk-cli ~0.36 + server-main ~0.28 + mcp:pandas fleet ~0.19-0.23 (the 2 data sessions; the canary children declare NO mcp_servers so they add no fleet) + external CTE ~0.10. The children add transcript-only cost (capped) + provider-CLI turns, NOT a fleet balloon. Well under the shared campaign_targets. STALENESS NOTE 2026-09-03: these numbers were recorded at the OLD N=1 default; the children scenario must be RE-RECORDED under N=4 (#1305) at the next release-gate run before its bounds are asserted - do not treat the 2026-07-19 numbers as current.
children.load: 3 concurrent claude-haiku sessions, real CTE; session 0 = S5 canary pack fanning out 2 background children (alpha+beta), sessions 1-2 = data-semantics; --settle-s >= 180
